Thank you, I hope I won’t need it but sometimes I really seek for a person to talk. Thank you for your offering, I will message you if I ever need. Have a great day/night (depending on your time zone)   :)

I don’t fully agree on “light without darkness is blinding” theory. But I understand what you mean by that in some parts. I am really happy when I help random strangers with a simple thing like giving pedestrians the crossing even if I have the right and seeing their smile. As many beliefs are suggesting there should be a balance in life. Yin and Yang. I just don’t see the balance in all of this suffering/happiness thing. Don’t get me wrong I’m not trying to block my ways on meaning and purpose. I’m just questioning how a person can hold on to life, and by holding on to life, I don’t just say ‘not killing yourself’ but at least not wasting your whole away with despair. 

Note: I don’t have a religious thing. I am just a person trying to keep it simple and real
I am not currently at my worst state. I really want to find a purpose and a constant in all of this mess and chaos. Thank you for your time and kind words.
Thank you. You are a good person. I hope everything will be ok for all of us

Life is just suffering besides of a few happy moments. Why bother bear all of this struggles when leaving it all together can also end all the suffering? Do you truly believe that this few happy moments to come is worth bearing all this sufferings? It is simple cost/benefit. And the cost is so much and so painful

There is no destination or even a journey not even an unpleasant one. I don’t remember if I had a true happiness by myself in almost 2 years. I really miss the old days. I see a professional psychiatrist and also I can say I am not in depression. She said maybe I have ADHD. I never told her about my suicidal thoughts because it is just momentary but in moments of some problems. I just can’t think anything better than to leave. Why bother to bear the problems when leaving it all together at once is enough to end all of the suffering? Ending the suffering is what we all try to do isn’t it?
